caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped metal plaque with raised lettering and imagery. The surface of the plaque is textured and rendered in shades of dark gray and brown, with areas of uneven color suggesting rust or corrosion. At the center of the plaque, there is a relief image of a horse-drawn fire engine with large spoke wheels and a central cab section, positioned sideways. Surrounding the fire engine image, there is embossed text following the curvature of the oval; the top half reads "FIRE DEPARTMENT" and the bottom half reads "INSURANCE." Two holes appear on either side of the plaque, likely intended for mounting. The background of the drawing is a plain light beige color. The name "EMILE CERO" is written in small capital letters at the bottom right corner of the composition.
title: Firemark
